Subject: Tri-region data residency deep-dive request

Hi Rishi / Neha —

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Greenleaf is consolidating our deployment plan for the new payments stack and we need a focused technical session to validate Redwood's proposed residency model across EU / US / APAC. High-level ask: 90-minute architecture review (network diagram, KV cache residency, fallback routing, and audit/log retention semantics).

Constraints: our compliance reviewers are in CET and APAC ops are available only in SGT evenings. Ideally we target a single session everyone can attend (I know that's tight) or two back-to-back blocks if necessary.

Can you propose 2–3 slots next week? We prefer:
- EU-friendly window (morning CET)
- A single recording + slide deck + network diagram ahead of time

I've attached our residency checklist to this note for context (greenleaf-residency-checklist.pdf). Also please share any pre-read network diagrams.

Attendees from our side: Oliver Hansen (Infra), Priya Suryan (Compliance).

Thanks,
Oliver

Head of Infrastructure, Greenleaf FinServ
oliver.h@greenleaf.com

Hi Oliver —

Appreciate the checklist — good context. We can absolutely run a 90-minute deep-dive and will come prepared with a proposed routing design (primary/secondary regions), KV cache residency options, and an ops runbook for failover.

Preliminary availability from our side (all times shown in CET / PT / SGT examples):
- Tue Mar 9, 09:30 CET / Tue Mar 9, 00:30 PT / Tue Mar 9, 16:30 SGT (90 min)
- Thu Mar 11, 08:00 CET / Wed Mar 10, 23:00 PT / Thu Mar 11, 15:00 SGT (90 min)
- Mon Mar 15, 14:00 CET / Mon Mar 15, 05:00 PT / Mon Mar 15, 21:00 SGT (split into two 45-min blocks if preferred)

Suggested agenda (45 + 30 + 15):
1) 45 min — architecture walkthrough (routing, model variants across regions, data flows)
2) 30 min — security/compliance controls (log retention, KMS, audit access, egress controls) — Neha leading
3) 15 min — open questions & next steps (rollout timing, canary plan)

Neha will own security details and Karthik will cover deployment orchestration and Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs. Marissa will bring the infra/ops checklist for cross-region failover.

If any of these slots work, send over a calendar invite and we'll add the pre-read. If none work, we can propose alternate times for APAC-heavy coverage (split session).

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Rishi —

Thanks for the options. Mar 9 is tight for our compliance reviewers. Mar 11 at 08:00 CET should work for most (that's Thu Mar 10, 23:00 PT, which is late for your US folks but our APAC reviewer can make it). Can you confirm Redwood can host that time and provide a recording and slides? Also: two asks before the call:

1) Can you circulate a pre-read including a high-level network diagram (region boundaries, ingress/egress, where KV caches live)?
2) We need an initial answer on how Redwood handles cross-border KV cache warming and whether prefix caching can be isolated to regionally pinned caches.

I'll send a calendar hold once you confirm. Attendees confirmed on our side: Oliver (Infra), Priya (Compliance), and potentially our cloud provider architect.

—Oliver
